text: Python CLI implemented as a single file password_checker.py
Uses Python standard library only (no third-party imports)
Policy rule: minimum length is checked and configurable
Policy rule: forbid common passwords (configurable list)
check reports every failed rule, not just the first
Compute and report Shannon entropy in bits
generate subcommand produces random passwords that satisfy the policy (cryptographically secure randomness implied)
Policy can be loaded from policy.json
validate-policy subcommand exists and reports invalid policy files
check signals pass/fail (e.g., exit status) so it is usable as a CLI tool
Errors (missing/malformed policy file, impossible policy) handled gracefully without traceback
